marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Universal rules for a successful interview

"There are some amazing jobs out there - but competition is fierce. To get your dream job, first you need to get through the job interview. So how do you succeed at this? This program gives you the low down of the modern job interview, including telephone, face-to-face, panel, sequential, and group interviews. It also clearly explains the preparation you need to do before the interview, how to dress for success and the ‘dos’ and ‘don'ts’ for a successful interview. Featuring a senior recruitment expert from KPMG, and excellent illustrative scenarios, this is an educational resource that will give you a clear path to achieving a successful interview"--VEA website.
